branch_states_shadowed.question: Q10
branch_states_shadowed.finding: Q10 carries a show-condition, and R8 jumps past it under the same circumstances. Whenever the show-condition would be false, the respondent has already been moved on, so the condition is never observed on its own. The two say the same thing. Worth confirming with the author that both are intended.

report.exhaustive_note: Every branch that can be reached on its own is reached, in both directions. 3 guard state(s) cannot be reached independently because a skip rule fires under the same condition; those are listed as shadowed, not as gaps.

not_enumerated.family: Every branch decision crossed with every other
not_enumerated.why_collapsed: Almost every combination walks a question sequence that another combination already walks. Only distinct sequences are testable as distinct journeys.
not_enumerated.residual_risk: A defect that depends on two branch values at once, where no rule in the specification relates them. Where a rule does relate them, the interaction checks pick it up.

not_enumerated.family: Quota state crossed with every completing journey
not_enumerated.why_collapsed: The quota decision is taken at one question and does not change anything before it, so one path per quota is sufficient.
not_enumerated.residual_risk: Low. Note the quota behaviour itself is absent from the built survey, which the conformance report already flags.

not_enumerated.family: Screening decisions crossed with anything after them
not_enumerated.why_collapsed: A respondent screened out never reaches a later question, so the combination does not exist.
